engine.description: The browser engine the cell ran on; a finding from before engines ran on chromium.

method.description: How this engine measured the check where engines differ: cls by layout-shift entries (Chromium) or sampled positions (WebKit); jank's long tasks by longtask entries or a timer's lateness, and whether slow frames could be split from raster-bound ones.

known.description: A known defect's issue (#N): the step's or flow's known mark, or the known-failing list's entry. Reported, never failing the run.

knownCase.description: The known-failing list's case this finding falls under (a flow file, or <file>:<cell name>).

advisory.description: An advisory finding (unusedRoute): reported, never counted by --fail-on.
